# TASK-157 — specification

## Scope

Task breakdown engine: a pure function splits an approved specification into an ordered task plan: foundations from the chosen stack, one epic per component, requirements ordered by priority, tests beside the requirement they verify (a derived test task when a requirement has none), use cases that wait for their requirements, "won't" items parked in the backlog, and the gaps it found (requirement without a component, without acceptance criteria). Cards gain `dependsOn`, kept by `.plan/tasks.md` (`— After: …`) without loss; existing cards keep their identifiers, columns and pull requests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] One deterministic function, not a model: foundations from the stack, one epic per component, requirements by priority, tests beside what they verify, use cases after their requirements, "won't" in the backlog, and a list of gaps.
- [x] Every item keeps its identifier as the card identifier, so boards that already exist keep their columns, assignees and pull requests; only grouping, order and `dependsOn` are refreshed.
- [x] Derived cards (a missing test, a stack setup) have their own identifiers and are marked obsolete, never deleted, when their source disappears.
